handback.title: Delete the old label approval and plan parser
handback.summary: Card draws and scans fetch only the issue's text and link, and the old plan code is gone.
handback.user_story: Card draws and scans ask GitHub less, and the old label approval and plan reader are gone.

acceptance_criteria.text: Fetching an issue for a card or a scan asks GitHub only for its text and link.
acceptance_criteria.words: `fetch_issue` still makes a paginated events call and parses edit history on every card draw and scan, and no caller reads `plan`, `changes` or `approved_at`. Keep the body and url fetch.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One fixed call with no input that varies; what the card reads is unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.text: The old label approval code is deleted.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A deletion takes no input, so it has no edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: The unused old work branch pattern is deleted.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A deletion takes no input, so it has no edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: The old checkbox plan parser is deleted.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A deletion takes no input, so it has no edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: The old plain text plan writer is deleted.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A deletion takes no input, so it has no edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: The old command that prints an issue's plan is deleted.
acceptance_criteria.words: `as_text` and the `plan issue` command. No workflow calls them; only tests do.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A deletion takes no input, so it has no edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: Listing the code owners still works as before.

edge_cases.case: A repo with no code owners file lists the repository owner.

acceptance_criteria.text: Tests that only check the deleted code are deleted too.
acceptance_criteria.words: Delete it, plus the tests that only exercise it.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Every test file is read the same way; there is no input to vary.
